notes: ATTRIBUTION: this is a #StopRansomware advisory about a financially motivated RaaS operation, coded A0; there is no state attribution of any kind. CONTI: Conti is lineage (Gunra is 'derived from' the Conti source code leaked in 2022), not a separate tool the actors deploy. It is marked core because the summary defines Gunra by it. 'Golden Community' is a branding alias of the same group. TEXT ARTIFACTS: 'KPNA' in the text is a typo for KNPA. Inline numerals ('Conti 1', 'Asia-Pacific. 2', 'documentation. 3', and so on up to 13) are footnote markers. Table 1 / 'Leveraged Tools' (the full tool list) is referenced but not in the input, so only tools named in the narrative are keyed. CVEs: CWE-288 is a weakness class, not a CVE. FortiOS and FortiProxy are recorded with the CVEs and not repeated as affected products. KNPA's 'credential-exposure and SSH access control vulnerabilities' in VPN gateways carry no CVE IDs. CORE CHOICES: details from single-victim KNPA/FBI case narratives are non-core. These include SSL-VPN default credentials, the unused account with its password-change bypass, VDI/RDP pivoting, session-cookie hijacking, the OTP-based MFA bypass, Hiware key theft, OpenSSH persistence, Mega exfiltration, NAS/database encryption, and backup deletion at the primary and DR centers. 'early 2026' (summary) and 'January 2026' (body) refer to the same RaaS launch, so credit either. RDP and SMB are protocols; RDP is listed as a tool and SMB as a technology, and either placement is acceptable. NON-SCHEMA FACTS a scorer may see in good outputs: double extortion; Tor-based negotiation portal and DLS (victims get a Client ID and password); ChaCha20 + RSA-4096 multi-threaded encryption; '.ENCRT' extension ('.CRYPT' in one July 2025 sample); static ransom note R3ADM3.txt; FindFirstFileW/FindNextFileW and IsDebuggerPresent APIs; exclusion of C:\Windows and Program Files directories and .exe/.dll/.sys files; no network indicators during encryption; log deletion and command-history clearing; datapub.news clearnet DLS mirror (a domain IOC); ransom demands of over tens of millions of US dollars paid to cryptocurrency wallets; emails to management staff; initial access brokers recruited from penetration testers and ethical hackers; unnamed RaaS components (management panel, configurable builder, cross-platform locker payloads). REGIONS/VICTIMS: no named victims and no country-level targets are stated; KNPA's participation does not make Korea a stated target region. Category alternates: OpenSSH, qTox and Mega are coded rmm_or_legit_software (commodity_or_open_source_tool is acceptable for OpenSSH). Tor is coded 'other' (anonymity network hosting the DLS and negotiation portal). Impacket and its scripts are coded commodity_or_open_source_tool. main.exe is the only actor-specific executable named besides the Gunra binaries (Windows encryptor and Linux variant).
